title: The vector list that tests/conformance/check reads
description: tests/conformance/vectors.json or a database's vectors.<driver>.json as the conformance checker reads it: the vectors by name, the chain each runs and its recorded expectation, which may be absent or null until a run records it. The checker refuses an empty list and an empty or repeated name itself; tests/conformance/schema/vectors.schema.json is the full form of a recorded file.
